groups.name: Household Finance Lab
groups.summary: How people with irregular incomes save, borrow and plan, and how app design nudges those choices.
groups.about: We run field experiments with fintech partners across West Africa, testing whether small design changes, like a default savings rate or a reminder at payday, change what people actually do with their money. Most of our work is with gig and informal-sector workers.
